body.description: One REST GoogleAdsRow of Q-G7 (FROM ad_group_criterion WHERE ad_group_criterion.type = 'KEYWORD' AND ad_group_criterion.status != 'REMOVED', plus either the range clause ad_group.id >= {ad_group_lo} AND ad_group.id <= {ad_group_hi} or the keyset clause ad_group.id = {ad_group_id} AND ad_group_criterion.criterion_id > {last_id} ORDER BY ad_group_criterion.criterion_id LIMIT 9999). The row arrives as one element of results[] in the search.json response envelope, which governs the request body and paging. Keys are camelCase; int64 values arrive as JSON strings and int32 values as JSON numbers. Q-G7 is the current state of every keyword, including keywords with no traffic: each entity sync writes one keyword row and one quality-score snapshot per keyword, even when Q-G5 returns no performance rows for it. Read order (AAP 0.3.3): criterion_id is unique only within its ad group, so Q-G7 first runs per ad_group.id range and halves any range that returns 10,000 rows; a single ad group that still returns 10,000 rows is read by keyset on ad_group_criterion.criterion_id in LIMIT 9999 pages, continuing while a page holds exactly 9,999 rows. Safe absence: a keyword is treated as removed or missing only after a complete read, with no failed or deferred page; an incomplete read marks google.entities incomplete and infers nothing.

adGroupCriterion.description: The FROM resource. The ad_group_criterion report returns only criteria explicitly added to the ad group; the type and status filters keep the keyword criteria that are not REMOVED.

resourceName.description: customers/{customer_id}/adGroupCriteria/{ad_group_id}~{criterion_id}. Always returned for the FROM resource.

criterionId.description: ad_group_criterion.criterion_id: INT64 as a JSON string. Unique only within its ad group, so the keyword's identity is (adGroup.id, criterionId); the keyset field of a single-ad-group Q-G7 scan.

status.description: ad_group_criterion.status (AdGroupCriterionStatusEnum v25), the status set by the client. Q-G7 excludes REMOVED; ENABLED normalises to active and PAUSED to paused. UNKNOWN is response-only and is a parse defect.

keyword.description: ad_group_criterion.keyword (KeywordInfo): always set for type = KEYWORD.

text.description: ad_group_criterion.keyword.text: STRING of at most 80 characters and 10 words. K2 adjacent terms exclude existing keyword texts and C3b checks cluster head tokens against them (AAP 0.5.4.3, 0.5.4.4).

qualityInfo.description: ad_group_criterion.quality_info. Absent when Google has no quality score for the keyword; proto3 JSON omits unset fields, and an empty object is accepted.

qualityScore.description: ad_group_criterion.quality_info.quality_score: INT32 as a JSON number, an integer from 1 to 10. May be unpopulated when Google does not have enough information to determine a value; it is then absent, parsed as None and never defaulted to 0. Each entity sync snapshots it as entity_snapshot.quality_score for the K3 fallback when Q-G5 daily scores are absent (AAP 0.5.4.3).

adGroup.description: Attributed resource ad_group; its resourceName is returned because ad_group.id is selected.

id.description: ad_group.id: INT64 as a JSON string; the range field of Q-G7 partitioning.

campaign.description: Attributed resource campaign; its resourceName is returned because campaign.id is selected.

id.description: campaign.id: INT64 as a JSON string.
